data.narrative: Reviewed the team-collaboration code through the five AI failure categories, closed the IDOR in the invitation flow with a substantiated ownership guard, proved it live with 9 probes, and converted the previously untested team feature into 17 committed regression tests.

dimension_scores.observation: The invitation build prompt named the file, endpoint, exact ownership check, error contract, and what not to change -- the 'good prompt' the module demonstrates, which prevented the placeholder-guard failure mode.
dimension_scores.evidence: team_router.py:133 require_owner_or_admin placed before any DB insert; agent report + live probe confirm substance, not placeholder.

dimension_scores.observation: Worked the IDOR symptom without reading ahead, then verified every permission boundary live: non-member create/list/revoke 403, dup pending 409, replay accept 400, revoked accept 400.
dimension_scores.evidence: m4_idor_probe.py 9/9 cases pass with exact status codes and messages.

dimension_scores.observation: The IDOR was closed on first build because the guard was a hard constraint in the prompt; zero fix iterations were needed for security.
dimension_scores.evidence: One delegation produced the guarded endpoints; review found no divergence.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified test coverage as the dominant real gap (the feature had zero committed tests) and closed it with 17 tests rather than accepting live-probe scripts as sufficient.
dimension_scores.evidence: tests/test_teams.py: 17 tests covering auth, role enforcement, dup/self/unknown, invalid input, owner-only actions; suite 75 -> 92 green.

dimension_scores.observation: Invitation flow is now production-shaped: one-time token, atomic accept transaction, expiry/status checks, owner-or-admin enforcement on all team mutations.
dimension_scores.evidence: Full suite 92 tests exit 0; live probes confirm the IDOR and replay are closed.

dimension_scores.observation: The IDOR finding, fix prompt, and verification are all documented, but the security finding deserves a standalone workspace note rather than only proof JSON.
dimension_scores.evidence: proof-aie-m4-break.json and proof-aie-m4-fix.json capture the full trace.

strengths: Closed the IDOR with a substantiated DB-backed ownership guard and proved it with 9 live probes including replay and revoked-accept cases.
Converted an untested feature into 17 committed regression tests, raising the suite from 75 to 92 green.
Applied the five-category lens to real code and empirically validated every edge case rather than assuming them.
growth_areas: Add a standalone security-incident note (IDOR finding + fix) to the workspace for reviewer visibility.
Consider enforcing that the accept endpoint's invitee email matches the authenticated user in a later iteration for stricter unauthorized-acceptance prevention.
data.recommendation: Carry the hybrid review method into Module 5 and apply the two-iteration rule: if a fix prompt does not converge in two iterations, restart the prompt rather than spiraling.
